Name: Lost Glades Greenhouse
Author: winterykite
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]96 Tree spots (4 times 24)[/size]
[*][size=3]900 Crop spots (4 times 15x15)[/size]
[*][size=3]A canal to refill your watering can[/size]
[*][size=3]You can till the area around the canal to plant rice and modded teas! (And other modded crops that require close proximity to water).[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Planned Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Spa for energy regeneration[/size]
[*][size=3]Dirt so you can plant cave carrots and voidshrooms if you're running Dwarvish![/size]
[*][size=3]Some decorations[/size]
[*][size=3]Maybe one of the corners could be for vanilla tea? Idk I plant that stuff around the canal. Or it could be for more water crops.[/size]
[/list][/font]
